title: Netherlands, Germany – Industry specific software development services – Expertise for the Control Room of the Future program (Dynamic Purchasing System - EU-404)
description: Welcome to the Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Expertise for the Control Room of the Future program and adjacent subjects. Note: This Dynamic Purchasing System is a continuation on the Mercell platform of the DPS that was previously operational on the Negometrix platform with Negometrix reference 159478 for which formal notice 2021/S 087-226573 was published on 5-May-2021 on the TED website. If your company was already qualified for participation on the Negometrix platform, a simplified procedure applies for re-establishing your qualification, see question 2.1 on the Mercell platform. TenneT will renew and innovate the (IT) systems that it uses for controlling and balancing its grids in the period 2021-2031. In connection with this, TenneT expects to be needing extensive external expertise, related to existing and new technologies and ways of working, in particular related to the challenges that TenneT faces in the energy transition. Compared to current ways of working, innovations will be needed to handle e.g. the increasing infeed of solar and wind energy that is far more difficult to predict and control than traditional generation. The subject of this tender procedure is a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for expertise (including the development of algorithms and IT Tools) that TenneT needs in connection with the renewal of its (IT) systems related to the control and balancing of the electricity transmission grid. Initially, the DPS contains the following categories of expertise: 1. power system control and monitoring; 2. energy platforms and interconnected IT systems; 3. data analysis, artificial intelligence and machine learning; 4. system and process implementation. This Tender Dossier contains the rules for the Application by Economic operators for qualification under this DPS. In order to become qualified for one or more of the categories, the Economic operator has to fulfil all the requirements of this DPS. In addition, the Economic operator needs to the answer all Mercell questions, and submit the requested documents and-or evidence at the respective Mercell question with the submission of its Application. During the course of time, the specific assignments (contracts) under the DPS will be tendered for which all suppliers that have qualified for the particular category will be invited to submit an offer. Any interested supplier may at any moment during the lifetime of the DPS submit a request to be qualified for participating in the tender procedures for specific assignments within one or more of the categories of this DPS. Your request will be accepted if it satisfies the applicable requirements and if you accept the stated conditions. Once you have qualified, you will automatically receive a notification when TenneT publishes a request for proposal for a specific subject within a category for which you have qualified. TenneT emphasises that it would also like to attract small and medium sized companies to this DPS. Qualification requests will be processed by TenneT in the sequence of receipt. TenneT will inform you as soon as possible and endeavors to do so within 10 working days from the date of receipt about the acceptance or rejection of your qualification request. During the lifetime of the DPS, TenneT will be entitled to add new categories, to close existing categories, and to split-up existing categories in to one or more categories.

description: Description: Mortgage-Backed Securities Operations & Analytics (MBSOA) The Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) is issuing this Sources Sought synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support this requirement for providing Mortgage-Backed Securities Operations & Analytics (MBSOA) in Support of the Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae) Office of Securities Operations (OSO). The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. This request for capability information does not constitute a request for proposals; submission of any information in response to this market survey is purely voluntary; the government assumes no financial responsibility for any costs incurred. This is not an evaluation of proposals but an assessment of vendors� capabilities. Therefore, a high-level assessment of the capability statements will be performed. Generic brochures are not being requested. Vendors should provide information to stress their competencies, differentiators, and past performance showing or demonstrating their ability to fulfill PWS requirements. This requirement is set-aside for the General Services Administration (GSA) Aliant 3 Government-wide Acquisition Contract (GWAC) holders. Each capability response must address the questions below. Responses that do not address the questions may not be evaluated or considered in the Government�s market research. Generic corporate brochures, marketing materials, or general descriptions of services that do not directly address the questions are insufficient. 1. Does your organization have experience working with government agencies such as Ginnie Mae, the Federal Housing Administration (FHA), Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or the Office of Public and Indian Housing (PIH) providing services similar in scope, size and complexity as the Performance Work Statement (PWS) requirements? 2. Does your organization possess the following special qualifications: an active Software Engineering Institute (SEI) CMMI Level III Certificate for Development, an active corporate ISO/IEC 20000 certification, an active corporate ISO 9001 (Quality Management) certification. 3. Describe your experience and current capability to support the MBSOA PWS services: 1) MBS Data Collection & Reporting services, 2) Information Technology services and Operations & Maintenance (O&M) services including Security and Enhancement activities, and 3) specialized MBS Risk and Information Analytic services. Include any related Ginnie Mae experience. Please indicate if your firm served as the prime contractor or subcontractor. 4. Provide examples of your company's experience supporting, managing, and modernizing a multi-platform, multi-provider environment that includes integrated legacy applications hosted in the cloud, while ensuring compliance with applicable requirements. 5. Provide an example where your firm improved operational efficiency, risk management, and information analytics capabilities, as well as investor reporting capabilities and accuracy for a client with similar requirements as this PWS within the secondary mortgage market or government-backed residential lending market. Include quantifiable results. 6. What are the three to five greatest risks associated with separating IT O&M from MBS business operations during contract period of performance, and what contractual, governance, technical, or operation controls would your company recommend to mitigate those risks? 7. Describe your company�s approach and protocol for maintaining 24/7/365 application and system availability, particularly during high-traffic events. Detail how your team identifies and mitigates technical challenges. 8. Based on your review of the PWS, are there any recommended changes, additions, or clarifications? Please identify the page number and paragraph. 9. Is your company able and willing to commit to providing services for a 10-year contract term? If not, please explain any limitations or concerns. If your organization has the potential capacity to perform these contract services, please provide the following information: 1) organization name, address, email address, website address, telephone number, and size and type of ownership for the organization; and 2) tailored capability statements addressing the questions and/or requested information listed above, with appropriate documentation supporting claims of organizational and staff capability. If significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, organizations should address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements. The government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to 1) provide services consistent in scope and scale with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated; 2) secure and apply the full range of corporate financial, human capital, and technical resources required to successfully perform similar requirements; 3) implement a successful project management plan that includes: compliance with program schedules; cost containment; meeting and tracking performance; hiring and retention of personnel and risk mitigation; and 4) provide services under a performance based service acquisition contract. Based on the responses to this Sources Sought Notice/Market Research, this requirement may be further set aside for any of the socio-economic programs, set-aside for small business competition, procured through full and open competition, procured through GSA, etc. Interested potential offerors must clearly specify the following: their Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), business size applicable to NAICS, socioeconomic business categories, GSA GWAC contract number, and any other applicable GWAC numbers. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submissions. Submission Instructions: Interested parties who consider themselves qualified to perform the above-listed services are invited to submit a response to this Sources Sought Notice by November 6, 2026, on or before 2:00 PM EST. All responses under this Sources Sought Notice must be emailed to Kimberly Campbell at Kimberly.M.Campbell@hud.gov and Jennifer Perez at Jennifer.M.Perez@hud.gov. Additional information on the required services is listed below. If you have any questions concerning this opportunity, please contact the Contracting Officer, Kimberly Campbell at Kimberly.M.Campbell@hud.gov and the Contract Specialist, Jennifer Perez, at Jennifer.M.Perez@hud.gov. Background: See Attachment A- Draft MBSOA PWS, Section 1.2. The Contractor shall support Ginnie Mae's core business functions: 1) Data Collection and Reporting, 2) System Support Services, as well as 3) Analysis and Risk Services. The Contractor is responsible for maintaining existing business applications and operations and for performing comprehensive risk management and data analysis activities necessary for Ginnie Mae to manage its financial risk as well as the financial risk of its program participants. description: Centers for Disease Control is issuing this synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support this requirement for Technical Assistance for Program Implementation, Messaging, Evaluation, and Translation Services in Support of Nutrition, Physical Activity, and Obesity Prevention. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of acquisition. The possible North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) codes are 541690 Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services, size standard of $19 million or 541611 Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services, size standard of $24.5M. There is no solicitation at this time. This request for capability information does not constitute a request for proposals; submission of any information in response to this market survey is purely voluntary; the government assumes no financial responsibility for any costs incurred. If your organization has the potential capacity to perform these contract services, please provide the following information: organization name, address, email address, website address, telephone number, and size and type of ownership for the organization; and tailored capability statements addressing the particulars of this effort, with appropriate documentation supporting claims of organizational and staff capability. If significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated to deliver technical capability, address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements. The government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to: provide services consistent in scope and scale with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated; secure and apply the full range of corporate financial, human capital, and technical resources required to successfully perform similar requirements; implement a successful project management plan that includes compliance with program schedules, cost containment, meeting/tracking performance, hiring/retention of key personnel, and risk mitigation; and provide services under a performance-based service acquisition contract. Based on the responses to this sources sought notice/market research and the Government questions attached to this Sources Sought Post, this requirement may be set aside for small businesses or procured through full and open competition, and multiple awards may be made. The government will not provide feedback or evaluations to companies regarding their submissions in response to this notice. Submission Instructions: Interested parties who consider themselves qualified to perform the above-listed services are invited to submit a response, no more than 3 pages, to include responses to the attachment 0002 Government questions, to this sources sought notice by Tuesday 10 November 2026. All responses under this notice must be emailed to Ann Bonis, won5@cdc.gov. Attachment 0001 DRAFT Performance Work Statement Attachment 0002 Government Questions Translation

description: Le présent marché a pour objet la structuration et la planification d’une communication numérique dédiée à la promotion des atouts touristiques de Troyes Champagne Métropole. This RFI does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid (IFB), or Request for Quotation (RFQ), and it is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to enter into a contract, nor will the Government pay for the information submitted in response to this request. All information contained in this RFI is preliminary and is subject to change if, and when, a solicitation is issued. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the U.S. Government to form a binding contract. If a competitive solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) website. It is the responsibility of the interested parties to monitor this site for additional information pertaining to this RFI, or future solicitations. The Department of Homeland Security, Federal Emergency Management Agency, Office of Direct Housing Operations, is conducting market research to identify and seek capabilities from industry in five primary functional areas: Automated Real Estate Aggregation and Vacancy Sourcing - Automated discovery and ingestion of residential rental property listings via Multiple Listing Services (MLS), property management software APIs, commercial rental boards, and direct landlord entry portals. - Real-time vacancy validation to prevent matching against obsolete or unavailable listings. - Rapid geo-fencing within disaster-declared zones and surrounding reasonable-commute perimeters. Artificial Intelligence and Algorithmic Matching - Multi-constraint matching algorithms that pair applicant household profiles with available properties in seconds. - Multi-point geospatial proximity optimization factoring in school district retention, work commutes, medical/provider travel distance, and essential services. - Household composition sizing aligned with HUD Housing Quality Standards (HQS) and FEMA occupancy guidelines. Automated Physical Accessibility Verification - Algorithmic filtering and computer vision inspection tools capable of evaluating floor plans, entry photos, and property specifications against UFAS and ADA physical accessibility standards. - Rapid identification of barrier-free environments, ramps, ground-floor units, grab bars, and wheelchair-accessible kitchens and bathrooms. Landlord Engagement and Leasing Workflow Automation - Automated outreach tools and self-service portals for landlords to submit properties, accept lease terms, and coordinate inspections. - Integration with standard government lease templates and automated electronic signature workflows. Secure Federal Architecture - Enterprise data security architecture compliant with the Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) at the Moderate impact baseline. - FedRAMP-authorized cloud hosting (or capability to achieve FedRAMP Moderate/High authorization). - Strict data protection for Sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) belonging to disaster survivors. NAICS CODE: 541512 (Computer Systems Design Services) / 531210 (Offices of Real Estate Agents and Brokers) PRODUCT SERVICE CODE (PSC): X1FA, Lease/Rental of Family Housing Facilities ANTICIPATED PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE START DATE: TBD RFI RESPONSE SUBMITTAL INSTRUCTIONS: Interested contractors shall submit Questions and RFI responses electronically to the Contracting Officer, at Rachel.Woods@fema.dhs.gov no later than 12:00PM Eastern Time (ET), December 18, 2026. Phone calls will not be accepted. Please see the attachment for further instructions and information.

title: Utilities Privatization of the Water System at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu
description: DLA Energy, in conjunction with the United States Army, plans to offer the privatization of the Water distribution (NAICS 221310) utility system at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii, Island of Oahu. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor(s) will be selected to assume ownership of the Water utility system. The new owner(s) shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner�s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. The Contractor shall be responsible for funding all capital investments required to acquire, maintain, and operate the utility system in a safe, reliable condition and to meet the requirements listed in the contract. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. The utility system will be conveyed via a Bill of Sale after a transition period to be determined by the Contractor. Past performance information from potential offerors shall be submitted as directed in the solicitation. A Sources Sought Notice for this requirement was previously publicized under solicitation number SP060026R0813 on May 29, 2026. The Sources Sought Notice has closed and market research is complete. This requirement will be unrestricted. All responsible sources are encouraged to submit an offer. Other-than-small businesses are required to submit a subcontracting plan with their offer. As part of the Army�s continuous transformation effort, initiatives are being implemented to transform how the Army operates, trains, and equips for C2 capabilities that enhance its lethality, mobility, and survivability in large-scale combat as part of the Joint Force. title: Netherlands – Research and development consultancy services – DAS Innovatie- en adviesdiensten
description: De gemeente Den Haag staat voor steeds complexere maatschappelijke opgaven, die vragen om nieuwe oplossingen, innovatieve werkwijzen en aanvullende expertise. Om hier adequaat op in te kunnen spelen, investeren verschillende domeinen en diensten binnen de Gemeente in innovatie en in het versterken van het eigen innovatievermogen. Bij de ontwikkeling en uitvoering van innovatieprocessen bestaat regelmatig behoefte aan aanvullende, specialistische expertise en ondersteuning van externe partijen. Deze behoefte kan per vraagstuk, fase van het innovatieproces en organisatieonderdeel verschillen. Om deze expertise op een flexibele, efficiënte en transparante wijze te kunnen inzetten, kiest de Gemeente voor het inrichten van een Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem (DAS). Binnen dit DAS kunnen marktpartijen die voldoen aan de gestelde toelatings- en geschiktheidseisen worden toegelaten en meedingen naar Nadere opdrachten. Het Schuldenlab070 neemt het initiatief tot het inrichten van een Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem (DAS), gericht op de begeleiding en ondersteuning van innovatieprocessen binnen de gehele gemeentelijke organisatie (gemeente Den Haag). Binnen dit DAS kunnen de verschillende domeinen en diensten op afroep en naar behoefte gespecialiseerde innovatiepartijen inschakelen. Doel hiervan is om expertise flexibel in te zetten ter versterking van het eigen innovatievermogen, en om werkzaamheden efficiënter, effectiever en duurzamer uit te voeren. Het uitgangspunt voor de opdrachten die binnen dit DAS worden uitgevraagd, is het innovatieproces zoals gebruikt bij onder andere het Schuldenlab070 en van EC-DISC (expertise Centrum Digitale innovatie en Smart City). Binnen deze processen worden concepten, experimenten en pilots ingericht en gevalideerd volgens een vaste en gefaseerde aanpak. Onder het innovatieproces vallen diverse standaarddiensten ter begeleiding en ondersteuning van innovatie(processen), waaronder bijvoorbeeld: -Probleemanalyse, trendanalyse en Strategische verkenning; -Het faciliteren en begeleiden van processen, werksessies en co-creatietrajecten; -Het begeleiden van de ontwikkeling en uitwerking van innovatieve concepten; -Projectsturing en programmabegeleiding; -Monitoring en evaluatie, waaronder maatschappelijke kosten-batenanalyses (MKBA) en impact- en effectmetingen. Daarnaast worden er regelmatig evenementen georganiseerd en trainingen gegeven die los staan van het innovatieproces. Het DAS is onderverdeeld in verschillende fasen van het innovatieproces. Ten behoeve van de inrichting en uitvoering van het DAS worden deze categorieën in Mercell/TenderNed als percelen weergegeven. Gegadigden dienen bij hun verzoek tot toelating aan te geven voor welke fase(n) zij in aanmerking wensen te komen. Het is toegestaan om zich voor één, meerdere of alle fasen aan te melden, mits wordt voldaan aan de voor die fase geldende eisen. Hoewel de gemeente binnen dit DAS primair opdrachten op het gebied van procesbegeleiding van sociale en fysieke innovatie zal uitzetten, kunnen ook opdracht worden uitgevraagd op het snijvlak van sociale en digitale innovatie. Hierbij kan gedacht worden aan de inzet van Artificial intelligence (AI) en andere digitale technologieën ter ondersteuning van innovatie, dienstverlening en besluitvorming, gericht op het effectiever aanpakken van sociaal-maatschappelijke opgaven. Onder deze DAS vallen dan de procesbegeleiding, maar niet de daadwerkelijke productontwikkeling van de digitale tools of systemen. Vraagstukken waarvan het primaire doel bestaat uit onderzoek, klantreisonderzoek, servicedesign of UX-design vallen niet onder de reikwijdte van dit DAS. Deze vallen namelijk onder de gemeentebrede raamovereenkomst voor de inhuur van Onderzoeks-, Service Design- en User Experience Design (UX)-medewerkers.

buyer: Agentur für Innovation in der Cybersicherheit GmbH (Cyberagentur)
title: Germany – Research and development services and related consultancy services – [AI-as-OS] Artificial Intelligence as Operating System
description: Artificial intelligence (AI) methods have been expanding into new areas of application for years. AI systems are increasingly capable of handling complex tasks with greater autonomy—for example, through agent-based approaches that run an AI agent on a computer to perform any task automatically or even autonomously, sometimes without explicit human instructions but rather based on identified intentions (see, for example, the open-source software OpenClaw, which can handle tasks such as calendar maintenance or file management). Just how deeply AI algorithms and models are now integrated into everyday applications is also evident in the fact that end devices are increasingly operable entirely without visible applications and exclusively via voice control, which fundamentally rethinks the way we interact with them (such as Deutsche Telekom’s AI Phone). The central control units of such end devices—the operating systems themselves—are also increasingly being enhanced with new AI functionalities to continuously improve system efficiency. These include initial theoretical—and in some cases already practical—approaches to using the latest AI technologies for file system or storage management. These developments mark a fundamental paradigm shift: AI is no longer viewed merely as an add-on, but increasingly as a native architectural component of the operating system itself. The AI-as-OS program aims to explore how artificial intelligence can be understood not merely as a separately encapsulated functionality that is simply executed by the operating system, but as the operating system itself—Artificial Intelligence as Operating System. Behind this lies the vision of an AI that not only supports individual applications but also acts as the central control system for the entire computer ecosystem, managing system resources (including the CPU, RAM, and system security) in a data-driven, adaptive, and context-aware manner. The aim of the program is to make fundamental contributions to the development of AI-based operating systems as the control unit of a computer system. Through the extensive integration of AI technologies into deep operating system layers, such a system is intended to manage system resources, enable context-aware operational decisions, and enhance system security through adaptive threat detection and defense. Since the underlying technology is still largely in a speculative stage, the scope of development work ranges from the general architecture of such an operating system to the integration of AI-based core mechanisms, and includes new considerations regarding the security and stability requirements for such an operating system, depending on the target platform (e.g., desktop, data center, edge device) and the application environment. The program’s main areas of research include: • AI-Centric Operating System Architectures: Concepts for the fundamental design of an operating system in which AI is viewed not as an add-on feature but as an integral part of the architecture. • AI-Native Core Mechanisms: Integration of AI-based methods into core operating system functions such as resource management, process control, and memory organization. • Control, Security, and Stability: Requirements for traceability, controllability, and robustness of an AI-based operating system, as well as approaches to adaptive threat detection and defense. From today’s perspective, it remains to be seen whether—and to what extent—the vision of an AI-native operating system can be technically realized. This is precisely where the program’s value lies: AI-as-OS explores a largely speculative field at the intersection of AI research and system software, the results of which could set the course for the operating systems of tomorrow.

title: Market research - AI Governance management
description: One of BR’s ambitions is to explore and responsibly harness the opportunities offered by artificial intelligence (AI). To ensure responsible use, and in view of BR’s duties as a public authority managing public information, sound governance of AI activities is essential. This includes robust procedures for ongoing assessments of risks, security, legislation and suppliers.To support this work, BR wishes to procure an AI governance tool. In 2024, a proof of concept (PoC) was conducted with the Finnish supplier Saidot. The PoC demonstrated the benefits of an AI governance tool for the agency by bringing all assessments together in one place.Much has changed since then. BR has procured a data and analytics platform from Google (Google Cloud Platform) and scaled up its AI activities. Various AI tools and opportunities are also being explored, creating a need for greater control and oversight.The purpose of this market survey is to identify AI governance solutions available on the market and determine how they support BR’s needs.

description: NAWCTSD will host a Pre-solicitation Teleconference (mini-Industry Day) for the CH-53E Baseline Configuration Upgrade (BCU) focused exclusively on the Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard. This standard is referenced for the development of software as a part of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. The pre-solicitation teleconference will take place on Thursday, 06 April 2017 from 1:00 - 3:00 pm EDT. The pre-solicitation teleconference will include a dedicated question and answer period allowing contractors to ask any questions related to the FACE portion of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. Answers to the questions generated from this pre-solicitation teleconference will be provided to all potential offerors. However, it should be noted that, all questions to the stated solicitation, unrelated to FACE, shall continue to follow normal protocol, with contractors submitting a completed L-1 Question and Answer Form and emailing it to Nicole Knight at Nicole.knight@navy.mil. All interested TSC III Lot II vendors are welcome to call in to this teleconference and should request the dial-in number from NAWCTSD Contracts, Nicole Knight (nicole.knight@navy.mil) no later than 2:30 pm EDT on Wednesday, 05 April 2017. In this request, include your company name, attendees’ names, email addresses, phone numbers, and company address to confirm attendance. Subcontractor requests must be requested through the Prime Contractor. All attendees’ for each company are encouraged to use only one call-in line. The Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard is the open avionics standard for making military computing operations more robust, interoperable, portable and secure. The standard enables developers to create and deploy a wide catalog of applications for use across the entire spectrum of military aviation systems through a common operating environment, resulting in lower implementation costs, standards that support a robust architecture and enable quality software development, more capabilities reaching the warfighter faster, and innovation and competition within the avionics industry. FACE is maintained by The Open Group FACE Consortium, a government and industry partnership to define an open avionics environment for all military airborne platform types. The FACE Consortium is a vendor-neutral forum that provides standardized approaches for using open standards with avionics systems. The FACE Consortium works to develop and consolidate FACE open standards, best practices, guidance documents and business models. The Government has included a brief entitled “FACE 101�? for interested contractors to review prior to the teleconference. A NAVAIR Subject Matter Expert (SME) will present this briefing and attendees are encouraged to download the briefing so that they can follow along as he presents the materials. For more information regarding FACE, including the FACE Standards, FACE Data Architecture, The Open Group Architecture Framework Technical Reference Model, and related documentation, please visit the Open Group website at: http://www.opengroup.org/face. Failure of an offeror to call-in to the conference or to submit any questions will be construed to mean that the offeror fully understands all requirements of the solicitation. Prospective offerors are advised that the teleconference will be held solely for the purpose of explaining the FACE Technical Standard as it relates to this solicitation. Grandview Blvd. � Waukesha, WI 53188 to procure a AssurePoint Standard Service Agreement for the following GE Healthcare system: GE PET Discovery MI-Digital Ready, System ID 301594DR710 and its DQA Imaging Phantom component ASSUREPOINT STANDARD SERVICE AGREEMENT INCLUDES: � 30 min ILINQ response time � System and tube coverage for up to 3,000 patients; � FE coverage Mon-Fri, 8AM-9PM; � 4 hrs. on-site response time; � iCenter Software Application � 30 min InSite response time; � InSite/Tech Phone Support � PM coverage Mon-Fri, 8AM-9PM; � Repair (OEM) parts next day 10:30AM; LST-PET � Software and quality updates; � TiP answer line; TiP-Ed online (TV) subscription; and � 97% uptime commitment. � GE Healthcare Factory-Trained/Certified Engineers/Servicing Personnel PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE: This will be a Base Year Plus Three Option Periods Firm Fixed Price Procurement. A determination by the Government not to compete with this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Any non-original equipment manufacturer (OEM) offerors to this solicitation must include enough information to establish the interested parties� bona-fide capabilities of providing all products and service (s) needed. Responses must be accompanied by descriptive literature, warranties and/or other information that demonstrates that the offer meets all the foregoing requirements. JUSTIFICATION FOR THE PROPOSED SOLE-SOURCE ACQUISITION: GE Healthcare is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and the sole source capable of providing the comprehensive preventive maintenance and repair services required for the Government-owned Discovery MI DR PET/CT Scanner. While the physical hardware may be present, the operational software architecture, predictive diagnostics, and advanced sub-system calibration protocols are strictly proprietary intellectual property owned exclusively by GE Healthcare. Utilizing an unauthorized third-party maintenance provider to service the scanner will immediately render existing service frameworks and software licensing agreements void, introducing severe operational, safety, and regulatory risks to the instrument's performance. All servicing personnel must be factory-trained and certified directly by GE Healthcare, possessing specific, continuous experience on this exact model that unauthorized third-party biomedical technicians completely lack. Introducing a new, uncertified contractor at this juncture would critically disrupt the Molecular Imaging Branch's (MIB) ability to perform daily diagnostic scanning on cancer patients enrolled in time-sensitive clinical trials, as an outside vendor cannot guarantee emergency response times, provide requisite software patches, or deliver necessary clinical applications support. The Discovery MI DR PET/CT system relies on a direct, secure, and encrypted remote network connection to GE Healthcare known as InSite. This proprietary platform allows GE Healthcare engineers to remotely monitor the PET/CT scanner in real time, view diagnostic error logs, isolate system anomalies, and deploy remote service repairs. This direct digital pipeline drastically decreases scanner downtime and cannot be accessed, licensed, or replicated by any third-party firm. Furthermore, the required service agreement covers technical and clinical applications telephone support provided directly by GE Healthcare specialists, which is an invaluable and non-replicable asset when constructing new patient research protocols. The agreement also provides exclusive end-user access to TiP-Ed Online, a proprietary clinical continuing education platform, and GE iCenter, a cloud-based asset maintenance and management software application. The iCenter platform tracks complete service and maintenance histories specifically for this Discovery MI DR PET/CT scanner, supporting critical workflow management, regulatory compliance, and improved patient outcomes. Because these essential cloud applications, remote diagnostic keys, and intellectual property rights are contractually non-transferable, they cannot be sub-licensed, bypassed, or passed through an unauthorized third-party broker. Consequently, GE Healthcare is the only source legally and technically capable of fulfilling this requirement. Le Concessionnaire aura notamment pour mission d’assurer : - L’amélioration continue des équipements et services du camping mis à disposition (sanitaires, accueil, aire de jeux et plateau sportif, point de restauration, distributeurs de boissons et snacking en dehors des ouvertures du point de restauration, services extérieurs comme la location de vélos électriques par exemple, des propositions d’activités en lien avec l’Adour et les berges …) - La gestion et l’exploitation du camping, caravaning, avec 70 emplacements minimum avec mobil’homes (dont 2 lodges) avec une montée en gamme des équipements existants. - Le classement aujourd’hui en trois étoiles doit être à minima maintenu voire amélioré en fonction de la proposition du délégataire - la modernisation des installations par la création d’une aire de camping-cars de 10 places minimum et le développement des services associés - la mise en oeuvre de la plantation de 50 arbres pour les emplacements non ombragés aujourd’hui, en coordination avec le service de la commune sur le choix des essences, les techniques de plantation et l’implantation des arbres - la promotion et la commercialisation des équipements sur des sites internet et plateformes de réservations d’hébergements touristiques et réseaux sociaux - l’entretien des ouvrages et bien matériels et immobiliers mis à disposition - l’accueil du public

title: 2027-2029 Maintenance Dredging, Anchorage Harbor, Alaska
description: THIS IS A PRESOLICITATION NOTICE ONLY FOR 2027-2029 MAINTENANCE DREDGING, ANCHORAGE HARBOR, ALASKA. OFFER OR BIDS WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED FOR THIS NOTICE. This solicitation will be an Unrestricted Procurement. Any resulting contract will be firm-fixed priced. The solicitation for this project will be available by INTERNET ACCESS ONLY and the anticipated download availability date for this solicitation will be on or after 27 October 2026. Access to the documents will be through a link on the SAM.gov website (http://www.SAM.gov). Use the Search function and use this solicitation number to Search by Solicitation/Award Number. Any future amendments to the solicitation will also be available for download from the link shared on the SAM.gov website. The Contractor shall comply with commercial and industry standards as well as all applicable Federal, State, and local laws, regulations, and procedures. The Construction Wage Rates (formerly Davis-Bacon Act) will apply. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code will be 237990 - Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, which has a size standard of $37 Million. The total estimated magnitude of construction for base and option items is between $25,000,000 and $100,000,000. The type of contract shall be firm-fixed price. The estimated award date of this contract is January 2027. This project is contingent on availability of funds. If the project is cancelled, all proposal preparation costs will be borne by the offeror. All offerors are advised that they must be registered in SAM.gov (http://www.sam.gov) when submitting an offer or quotation and at time of award. Joint ventures must also be registered in SAM.gov as a joint venture. Offerors who are not registered in SAM.gov should consider applying for registration immediately. See (https://ww.sam.gov) for information on registration. DESCRIPTION OF WORK: Perform surveying, dredging and disposal of approximately 900,000 cubic yards of fine-grained shoaled material annually for three (3) years at the Anchorage Harbor with an option to annually dredge 350,000 cubic yards of sandy material with some cobbles in Cook Inlet Navigation Channel. The dredging must be accomplished in a manner that keeps the Port of Alaska dock face and terminals accessible for shipping traffic at all times. The Cook Inlet Navigation Channel, which is the marked entrance through Knik Arm Shoal to Anchorage Harbor, may also require periodic maintenance dredging. The Contractor is to furnish all labor, equipment, supplies, materials, supervision and other items and services necessary to accomplish the work. All maintenance dredging in Anchorage Harbor and Cook Inlet Navigation Channel shall be performed using hopper or mechanical dredges only. Cutterhead, suction and pipeline dredges are not permissible. The type of contract shall be firm-fixed price. Construction wage rates (formerly Davis-Bacon Act wage rates) shall apply. NOTE: Electronic proposal submissions will be accepted via the PIEE Solicitation Module website at: https://piee.eb.mil/sol/xhtml/unauth/index.xhtml. Search via Solicitation Number Search W911KB27RA002. Additional information concerning PIEE can be found at: https://pieetraining.eb.mil/wbt/xhtml/wbt/sol/index.xhtml

title: Tybee Island Shoreline Protection Project
description: This presolicitation is for the Tybee Island Shoreline Protection Project. This acquisition is being offered as an unrestricted full and open competitive solicitation and will result in a single Firm Fixed- Price Contract Award. The construction magnitude for this project is between $10,000,000.00 and $25,000,000.00. Description of Work: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Savannah District, intends to issue an Invitation for Bid (IFB) to award a single firm fixed-price contract. Project work consists of placing dredged material along the Front Beach at Tybee Island, Georgia. The Contract includes a Base Bid item and Optional Bid items. The Base Bid item consists of placing berm fill material along approximately 7,000 feet of the construction baseline. Optional Bid items include placing additional material along the Front Beach area. The berm width varies along the project length. The Base Bid quantity is approximately 820,000 cubic yards of material and the four Option Bid items consist of approximately 673,000 cubic yards of material to be dredged for this renourishment. The material for the project will be sourced from an approved offshore borrow area that is approximately 5,000 feet away from the south end of the project and 11,000 feet from the center of the project. Work also includes environmental restrictions and beach tilling. The total construction duration for this project is 90 days from Notice to Proceed (NTP). Evaluation Criteria: The contract will be solicited and procured using FAR Part 14 Sealed Bidding Procedures. Note: The Government anticipates issuing the invitation for bids on or after 06 November 2026. This date is estimated and subject to change. Actual dates and times will be identified in the solicitation. The solicitation will be issued in electronic format only and will be made available through the System for Award Management (SAM) website at https://sam.gov/. Interested parties are encouraged to register as an interested vendor on SAM.gov to receive notifications of solicitation amendments. The Government is not responsible for notifying interested parties who have not registered or otherwise monitored SAM.gov for updates. Prospective bidders must be registered in SAM.gov at the time of bid submission and maintain an active registration through contract award, in accordance with FAR 52.204-7. The only authorized transmission method for a bid in response to this solicitation is electronically via the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) Solicitation Module. NO OTHER TRANSMISSION METHODS (EMAIL, FACSIMILE, REGULAR MAIL, HAND CARRIED, ETC.) WILL BE ACCEPTED. The bids must be received by the Government by the date/time specified in the solicitation. Bidders shall submit their bid via the PIEE website Solicitation Module using the following link: https://piee.eb.mil/. Instructions on how to submit a bid can be found using the following link https://pieetraining.eb.mil/wbt/sol/Posting_Offer.pdf. Contractual Questions should be forwarded to Contract Specialist, MSG Jeffrey Francisco at jeffrey.o.francisco.@usace.army.mil or to the attention of the Contracting Officer, Mr. Preston Jones at preston.e.jones@usace.army.mil.

When any change in design, material, servicing or part number is made to replace or substitute any item to be furnished on this contract/purchase order, the Contractor shall furnish, for the substituting/replacement item, a drawing and an explanation of the reason for the change, explaining the reason therefor. The most probable causes of contamination are direct-connected manometers, mercury vacuum pumps, mercury seals, or the handling of mercury in the immediate vicinity. Mercury switches, mercury in glass thermometers, standard cells and other items containing mercury may be used if they are located so as not to constitute a contamination hazard. If external contamination by metallic mercury occurs or is suspected, the following test may be used to determine whether contamination by metallic mercury exists or whether corrective cleaning measures have been effective. Enclose the equipment in a polyethylene bag or close-fitting airtight container for eight hours at room temperature (70 degrees F minimum).Sample the trapped air and if mercury vapor concentration is 0.01 mg/cu meter or more, the material is mercury contaminated insofar as the requirements of this contract are concerned. title: INTELLIGENCE, SURVEILLANCE, ANDRECONNAISSANCE (ISR) SYSTEMS AND INFORMATION OPERATIONS (IO) FROM SEABED TO SPACE (S2ISR)
description: Note: A Market Survey to Assess Small Business Capability was posted for this procurement on 05 March 2025 under E-Commerce control number MKTSVY-0019F306, REFERENCE NUMBER: N6600125R0025. The Naval Information Warfare Center (NIWC) Pacific intends to issue Request for Proposal (RFP) No. N6600126R0019 for Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) Systems and Information Operations (IO) from Seabed to Space (S2ISR). The services contemplated under this effort will provide the Navy with the ability to develop and field ISR systems that incorporate the latest capabilities for maintaining robust communication, surveillance, and security to accommodate advances in technology and other complementary systems while countering ever-increasing threats. The Government contemplates that, in its capacity, the contractor will provide technical support services in the form of algorithm development, data design processing, hardware and software development, fabrication, installation, testing, deployment, recovery, repair, systems engineering, program and configuration management, logistics, maintenance, sustainment, training, environmental support, and analysis in support of ISR activities, ISR systems, and corresponding cybersecurity operations. ISR activities may include support related to chemical, nuclear, biological, and radiological (CNBR) elements related to unmanned system. ISR systems may include surveillance programs, systems, networks, and tactical data communications systems including automated radio communications systems, satellite terminal systems, and space, air, land and water autonomous or non-autonomous systems that could be used in ISR operations. Contract activities may be performed throughout the world. In addition, work may be performed onboard afloat vessels (including U.S. Coast Guard vessels), in port, or at sea alongside coalition partner nations (e.g., NATO countries). It is anticipated that the procurement will result in the award of multiple indefinite-delivery, indefinite quantity (IDIQ) contracts with cost-plus-fixed-fee (CPFF) and cost (no fee) pricing arrangements. The period of performance will include a seven-year ordering period. Orders will be placed pursuant to the ordering processes of FAR 16.505(a). The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 541715 Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering and Life Sciences, excluding nanotechnology and biotechnology and the Small Business Size Standard is 1,000. Security classification will vary from Unclassified to Top Secret/Incidental Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) classification. This requirement will be competed on a full-and-open basis. This is a follow-on requirement covered by contracts N6600121D0053 through 0063. NIWC Pacific anticipates that the final RFP for N6600126R0019 will be released no earlier than 21 November 2025. The solicitation will be available electronically via the Solicitation Module within the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) website at https://piee.eb.mil, under Notice ID N6600126R0019.

title: Firefox
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) has developed a non-invasive coherent optical system capable of recording neural signals in humans. To expand this foundational technology and enable the development of revolutionary, non-invasive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), DARPA's Firefox program is soliciting approaches to overcome key technological hurdles: 1) development of components enabling dynamic rastering/scanning of the incoming coherent optical signal to target multiple regions of interest and 2) development of new data processing architectures beyond the digital domain to handle the high data rates and computational burden inherent to scaling the amount of neural data recorded by the optical system. The ultimate goal of the Firefox program is to use these innovations to develop a 100-channel, non-invasive BCI with 50-micron spatial and 100-microsecond temporal resolution.

description: COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION TEMPLATE (FAR 12.603) General Information This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or services prepared in accordance with the format in subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 140RR027R0010 is issued as a Request for Quote (RFQ). The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2026-01. It is the responsibility of the contractor to be familiar with the applicable clauses and provisions. They may be accessed in full text at the following websites: https:/www.acquisition.gov/far/ and https://www.acquisition.gov/diar. This combined synopsis & solicitation notice is a request for competitive quotations. Therefore, all capability statements or quotations received prior to the RFQ close date will be considered. The associated North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 238990 with an associated small business size standard of $19M. Description of Services: The Department of Interior (BOR) require delivery date for an automated vehicular main entrance at the Pleasant Grove Office (PGMB)�capable of reliably controlling entry and exit and fully securing the existing driveway/entrance. Installation, testing, commissioning, and training shall be performed by the contractor at the Government�s destination. Statement of Objectives (SOO) 1. Purpose The purpose of this requirement is to provide an automated vehicular main entrance at the Pleasant Grove Office (PGMB) that reliably controls entry and exit and fully closes the existing driveway/entrance. The objective is to install a gate solution that integrates with the site's existing access-control infrastructure; card/badge readers and exit loop/coil, supports safe daily operations, and improves security. In addition to providing AHJ-approved emergency responder access at the new automated main entrance gate, the contractor shall standardize emergency responder access across the site by retrofitting two existing automated access gates with Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ)-approved emergency access key switches or equivalent devices. Each emergency access device shall be integrated with the respective gate operator control circuit to provide immediate emergency opening without replacement of Government access-control components and without defeating required gate safety functions. 2. Background The mission of the Bureau of Reclamation is to manage, develop, and protect water and related resources in an environmentally and economically sound manner in the interest of the American public. The mission of the Provo Area Office is to carry out this mission by supporting safe, reliable facility operations and daily activities at PGMB. This acquisition will deliver a complete gate solution that integrates with existing site infrastructure, including an existing electrical power source near the main entrance, installed card and badge readers for credentialed entry, and an existing loop/coil sensor that allows motor vehicles to exit the facility, and will standardize emergency responder access across all automated vehicular gates at PGMB. The main vehicular entrance is approximately forty feet (40 feet) wide. For planning purposes, the Government anticipates that approximately twenty-five feet (25 feet) of the entrance will be served by an automated vehicular gate, with approximately fifteen feet (15 feet) of chain-link infill tying into the existing fence line to close the remaining portion. These dimensions are approximate. Offerors shall verify field dimensions and site conditions and may propose the final gate configuration necessary to achieve the required security, access-control, safety, aesthetic, and operational outcomes. The current main entrance configuration has two individual gate leaves that are twenty feet (20 feet) each. To improve security and daily operations, the Government seeks a secure, access-controlled solution that closes the entrance and blends seamlessly with the existing chain-link fencing. For purposes of this requirement, security means controlling vehicular and personnel access to the facility, restricting unauthorized entry under normal operating conditions, maintaining reliable closure of the entrance, and integrating with the existing access control system. Existing Conditions and Key Constraints: � Aesthetic Continuity: Maintaining a clean, durable chain-link aesthetic that matches the existing fence visual continuity in pattern, alignment, and finish is required. � Height Matching: Matching the existing fence height at the tie-in location. � Access Integration: Integrating the new gate operator with the existing entry and exit access control system. � Safety and Reliability: Providing safe, reliable automation with entrapment protection, manual release, and commissioning proper operation. � Site Disruption: Minimize impact to staff, visitors, and ongoing site activities during installation. � Environmental Design: Designing the assembly for local wind and snow conditions. � Sustainability and Warranty: Provide maintainable equipment, warranty coverage, and Operations and Maintenance manuals. 3. Scope Offerors shall propose and furnish a complete entrance gate solution for the Bureau of Reclamation�s PGMB that achieves the outcomes identified in Section 4.0. The scope includes the overall management and integration of the work necessary to deliver a secure, access-controlled, automated entrance. Offerors will define their means and methods in their proposed Performance Work Statement. The solution shall close the existing entrance, which is approximately forty feet (40 feet) wide, using an automated vehicular gate solution serving approximately twenty-five feet (25 feet) of the entrance together with approximately fifteen feet (15 feet) of chain-link infill tying into the existing fence line, subject to field verification. Offerors shall determine the final dimensions, configuration, and means and methods necessary to achieve complete entrance closure. Integrate with the site's existing card and badge readers for credentialed entry and with the existing exit loop or coil sensor for automatic egress. Utilize the existing electrical power source, subject to field verification of voltage, circuit capacity, and suitability. Maintain a clean, durable chain-link aesthetic that matches or complements the existing fence and height; and support reliable daily operations under local wind and snow conditions while minimizing disruption during installation. The work shall include dismantling and removal of the existing main entrance gate leaves and associated hardware as required to install the new system. All removed gate materials shall be lawfully disposed of offsite. Existing fence, access-control components, utilities, and other features designated to remain shall be protected from damage. The new automated entrance gate shall include an AHJ-approved means of emergency responder access integrated with its gate operator. In addition, the contractor shall retrofit two existing automated access gates at PGMB with AHJ-approved emergency access key switches or equivalent devices. The emergency access work shall include all required interface components, wiring, conduit, labeling, enclosures, and mounting hardware. Each device shall be integrated directly with the respective gate operator control circuit to allow immediate opening by emergency responders while maintaining applicable UL 325 safety requirements. The contractor shall coordinate device type, mounting location, and installation details with the Fire Code Official and obtain all required approvals prior to installation. buyer: PD - Berater der öffentlichen Hand GmbH
title: Germany – Public relations services – Kommunikations- und Veranstaltungsleistungen im Rahmen der Koordinierungs- und Transferstelle Smart Cities (KTS)
description: Auftraggeber ist die PD Berater der öffentlichen Hand GmbH (PD). Die PD benötigt Unterstützung bei der Erledigung ihrer Aufgaben. Das vom Kunden im Jahr 2019 aufgelegte Förderprogramm „Modellprojekte Smart Cities“ umfasst in drei Staffeln 73 Modellprojekte Smart Cities (MPSC). An diesen MPSC sind insgesamt 89 Städte, Kreise und Gemeinden unmittelbar beteiligt, die jeweils einen eigenen Fördervertrag mit der Kreditanstalt für Wiederaufbau (KfW) abgeschlossen haben. Auf Grundlage der Smart City Charta sollen Städte und Gemeinden durch das Förderprogramm dabei unterstützt werden, 1. digitale Entscheidungsgrundlagen und intelligente Lösungen in Kommunen und Regionen zu er-arbeiten, 2. Lernprozesse für die gesamte Bandbreite der kommunalen Landschaft anzustoßen sowie 3. wirksame Beiträge zu einer integrierten und nachhaltigen Stadtentwicklung zu leisten. Seit 2021 unterstützt die PD mit der Koordinierungs- und Transferstelle Modellprojekte Smart Cities (KTS) die geförderten Kommunen durch fachliche Begleitung, Wissenstransfer, Vernetzung sowie weitere Unterstützungs- und Serviceangebote. Ein Teil dieser Angebote richtet sich auch an nicht geförderte Kommunen. Ziel ist es, die im Förderprogramm gewonnenen Erkenntnisse, entwickelten Lösungen und entstandenen Wissensprodukte über die geförderten Projekte hinaus zugänglich zu machen, ihre Übertragung in die kommunale Praxis zu unterstützen und zu ihrer Verstetigung beizutragen. Die Kommunikation und Fachöffentlichkeitsarbeit bilden hierfür eine wesentliche Grundlage. Sie machen Ergebnisse und Entwicklungen des Förderprogramms sichtbar, bereiten Wissen adressatengerecht auf und unterstützt dessen Verbreitung und Nachnutzung. Die bestehende Website smart-city-dialog.de dient dabei als zentrale Wissens-, Kommunikations- und Vernetzungsplattform. Ergänzend werden insbesondere redaktionelle Formate, soziale Netzwerke sowie die Presse- und Fachöffentlichkeitsarbeit genutzt. Gegenstand des vorliegenden Auftrags ist die strategische, redaktionelle und operative Erbringung der Kommunikations-, und Veranstaltungsleistungen, die Redaktion und Produktion von online Content für Website und sozialen Medien, die Presse- und Fachöffentlichkeitsarbeit sowie die vollständige inhaltliche und organisatorische Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von zwei Kongressen als nationalen Leitveranstaltungen des Förderprogramms. Der Förderzeitraum der letzten MPSC endet im ersten Halbjahr 2028. Im Verlauf des ausgeschriebenen Auftrags werden sich die Tätigkeitsschwerpunkte daher von der Begleitung laufender Förderaktivitäten zunehmend auf die Sicherung, Aufbereitung, Verbreitung und Verstetigung der Programmergebnisse verlagern. Diese Entwicklung ist bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung der Leistungen zu berücksichtigen. Der Auftrag umfasst folgende Lose. Die Bieter können für ein oder mehrere Lose bieten: Los 1: Redaktion und Content-Produktion Los 2: Presse- und Fachöffentlichkeitsarbeit Los 3: Kongresse

description: The Los Angeles District, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers is seeking to lease suite/s with a total of 3,560 net/usable to a maximum of 3,979 gross/rentable square feet (gross square feet to include any common area factor), of existing Class A or B retail space, in the city of Glendora California and within the defined Delineated Area (DA) boundaries below: North � Orangepath St W South � US Route 66 East � Vecino Dr. West � Barranca Ave. The Government�s desire is for a full-service lease of Retail space for an Armed Forces Career Center for a term not to exceed five (5) years with Government termination rights. Offered space must meet Government requirements per the terms of the Government Lease. Interested respondents may include building owners and representatives with the exclusive right to represent building owners. Representatives of building owners must include the exclusivity agreement, representation letter, listing contract or other executed agreement granting the exclusive right to represent the building owner with their response to this advertisement. Adequate mass transit (buses, trains, rail cars) for the public within three walking blocks is highly desired. REQUIRED --Spaces MUST offer both a primary and a secondary point of ingress/egress. --Lighted, non-exclusive or reserved on-site parking for eight (8) marked government owned vehicles must be provided for on 24 hours 7 days a week basis. Additional lighted parking must be available during business hours, weekends and holidays, for approximately eighteen (18) employee vehicles and visitors/recruit candidate parking. --Must use the Government Lease. --The military services shall have the right to use space beyond normal working hours and, if required, on Saturdays, Sundays, and Federal holidays. This includes the use of elevators, lights, toilet facilities, and, if necessary, heating and air conditioning. --Armed Forces Recruiting Facilities are only located in defined geographical areas that contain businesses and other establishments that are of a compatible nature. Under no circumstances will be these facilities to be in areas where sexually oriented businesses, bars, nightclubs, liquor stores, smoke shops, marijuana dispensaries etc. or other business that produce injurious odors detectable with the leased spaces. Placement near these establishments can hamper overall production of the office or cause concern for the safety of the personnel stationed there and their visitors. title: Collaboration Opportunity: Efficient Adsorptive Recovery of HREEs and Critical Minerals from Coal Derivatives
description: Opportunity: NETL is actively seeking collaboration to advance and commercialize an innovative adsorptive method for the highly efficient recovery of Heavy Rare Earth Elements (HREEs) and other Critical Minerals (CMs) from coal and its derivatives. This groundbreaking approach integrates physical enrichment for feedstock pre-concentration, significantly enhancing overall process efficacy. Background: Traditional HREE/CM extraction from coal derivatives is often costly, energy-intensive, and chemical-laden. Existing multi-step chemical extraction operations rely on vast amounts of expensive solvents and chemicals, resulting in low recovery and impure products due to inherently low REE concentrations. The heterogeneity of coal byproducts also demands complex pre-treatment, preventing a universal solution. Thus, there is an urgent need for cost-effective extraction technologies that significantly reduce chemical and energy consumption while offering feedstock flexibility. Description: NETL researchers have developed a process for the cost-effective recovery of concentrated HREEs and other critical minerals (CMs), including Gallium, Germanium, Vanadium, Cobalt, and Nickel. This method significantly reduces processing time to less than 5 minutes, demonstrates high selectivity for HREEs and CMs over fouling metals exceeding 1,000, and is proven effective with coal, coal refuse, and their derivatives. The core process involves an adsorptive technology to recover HREEs and CMs from coal and coal-derived solutions, followed by the release of high-purity HREEs and CMs through a pH-swing regeneration operation. Configured with multiple adsorption columns, the method can be continuously operated. It also incorporates a physical separation step, flotation or sonication enhanced flotation, for pre-concentrating REEs within the feedstock. This unique NETL method successfully recovers HREEs and CMs from feedstocks even at parts-per-million concentrations. By offering unparalleled low-maintenance requirements, affordability, and scalability compared to existing alternatives, it establishes a new standard for HREE/CM recovery technology. Advantages/Benefits: Improved cost efficiency. Minimal pressure drop. High capacity and selectivity for HREEs Short sorption contact times. Regenerable and robust performance tested in cyclability studies. Potential Applications: Coal refuse/waste streams Mine tailing/waste streams Acid mine drainage Industrial demineralization Development Status: Current stage of technology development: TRL ? 0-2 ? 3-5 ? 5-9 NETL has filed for patent protection on this invention. NETL is actively seeking industry partners with the capability and vision to bring this critical technology to market. By moving this innovation beyond the laboratory and into commercial application, our partners can gain a significant competitive advantage through licensing and/or cooperative research and development collaborations. Interested parties are invited to discuss this opportunity further under non-disclosure agreements to safeguard proprietary information. NOTE: THIS IS NOT A PROCUREMENT. Entities interested in developing technologies for HREE and CM recovery should provide an electronic or written statement of interest, which includes the following: 1. Company Name and Address 2. A description of the relevant expertise and/or facilities Please provide a complete statement to ensure consideration of your interest in this opportunity. title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Einführung von Ki in der Eingangsverarbeitung
description: Gegenstand des Verfahrens: Der Beitragsservice von ARD, ZDF und Deutschlandradio beschafft einen KI-basierten Service zur automatisierten Verarbeitung eingehender schriftlicher Sendungen (Papier/Scan, E-Mail, Fax), der als Managed Service (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) auf einer souveränen Cloud betrieben werden soll. Der KI-Service klassifiziert die Sendungen nach der Dokumentart-Systematik des Beitragsservice (DAK/SDAK), erkennt das fachliche Anliegen und extrahiert die für die Weiterverarbeitung erforderlichen Fachdaten. Die Ergebnisse werden jeweils mit einem Confidence-Score als strukturierte JSON-Objekte an den bestehenden Verarbeitungsprozess zurückgegeben. Der KI-Service wird nicht als Ersatz, sondern als Bypass zur bestehenden Eingangsverarbeitung eingeführt. Die Aussteuerung der Sendungen erfolgt über vom Beitragsservice bereitgestellte intelligente Weichen; die Kernsysteme bleiben unverändert. Nicht Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind das Scannen bzw. die Digitalisierung der Sendungen, die Ein- und Ausgangsschnittstellen der Gesamt-Eingangsverarbeitung sowie die intelligenten Weichen selbst. Der Leistungsgegenstand gliedert sich in drei Bausteine: Baustein 1 - Cloud-Infrastruktur: Bereitstellung einer souveränen, hochverfügbaren und skalierbaren Cloud-Umgebung als IaaS einschließlich bedarfsgerecht skalierbarer CPU-, GPU-, Speicher- und Netzwerkressourcen für KI-Workloads. Es ist beabsichtigt, einen Vertrag über die Bausteine 1 und 2 mit einer 4-jährigen Festlaufzeit abzuschließen. Baustein 2 - Managed Service: Betrieb der KI-Plattform als PaaS und SaaS, insbesondere Monitoring, Logging, Incident- und Problem-Management, Patch- und Release-Management, Backup und Recovery, Kapazitätsmanagement sowie Bereitstellung und Betrieb eines standardisierten KI-Serving-Stacks (u. a. Container-Orchestrierung, Inferenz). Der Beitragsservice behält die Hoheit über Fachlogik, Agenten sowie Auswahl und Wechsel der KI-Modelle. Es ist beabsichtigt, einen Vertrag über die Bausteine 1 und 2 mit einer 4-jährigen Festlaufzeit abzuschließen. Baustein 3 - Entwicklung einer individuellen Input-Management-Lösung ("KI-Service"): Konzeption, Entwicklung, Integration und Produktivsetzung einer individuellen Lösung auf Basis der bereitgestellten Plattform, einschließlich Einrichtung von Klassifikation und Extraktion je Sachverhalt, Nachweis der vereinbarten Erkennungsqualität, Schulung, Dokumentation und Unterstützung der Abnahme. Der KI-Service inkl. sämtlicher Arbeitsergebnisse (u. a. Quellcode, Konfigurationen, Prompt-Artefakte, Datenmodelle, Schnittstellenbeschreibungen, Tests, Dokumentation) geht mit zeitlich, räumlich und inhaltlich unbeschränkten Nutzungsrechten auf den Beitragsservice über. Dem Beitragsservice ist zudem das Recht einzuräumen, den KI-Service uneingeschränkt zu nutzen, zu betreiben, zu verändern und weiterzuentwickeln sowie durch Dritte betreiben oder weiterentwickeln lassen können. Es darf keine Abhängigkeit vom ursprünglichen Auftragnehmer entstehen und ein Anbieterwechsel muss grundsätzlich möglich sein. Die Lösung ist vorrangig auf Basis von Open-Source-Komponenten mit permissiven Lizenzen zu realisieren. Ergänzend ist ein Dienstleistungskontingent für weitere Sachverhalte vergleichbarer Komplexität und für Optimierungen nach der Produktivnahme bzw. Abnahme vorzusehen. Fachlicher Umfang und Mengengerüst: Schwerpunkt sind rund 1,8 Mio. formlose Schreiben pro Jahr, die bislang weder automatisch klassifiziert noch inhaltlich ausgewertet werden. Hinzu kommen rund 4,7 Mio. formgebundene Schreiben aus fünf Sachverhalten: Befreiungen, Abmeldungen, Drittschuldnererklärungen, Klärungsverfahren aufgrund Sterbefall sowie Bank- und Adressänderungen. Für die Dimensionierung ist von mindestens 6,5 Mio. Sendungen pro Jahr auszugehen (ca. 25.000 Sendungen je Arbeitstag, Spitzenwert ca. 26.700). Der Handschriftanteil liegt bei ca. 20 %. Teilweise sind besondere Kategorien personenbezogener Daten nach Art. 9 DSGVO (z. B. Gesundheitsangaben) zu verarbeiten. Wesentliche funktionale Anforderungen sind insbesondere: - KI-gestützte Texterkennung (OCR) über den gesamten Dokumentinhalt einschließlich mehrseitiger Dokumente und Anlagen; - inhaltsbasierte Klassifikation und Anliegenerkennung mittels Textverständnis statt Formularankern, einschließlich Erkennung mehrerer Anliegen je Sendung und Trennung mehrerer Dokumente; - Extraktion der Identifikationsfelder (u. a. Beitragsnummer, Name, Anschrift) und der je Sachverhalt benötigten Fachdaten, auch aus beigefügten Nachweisen; - Erkennung handschriftlicher Inhalte einschließlich freier Randnotizen, Ankreuzfelder und Prüfung auf Vorhandensein von Unterschriften; - Confidence-Scores je Ergebnis und Feld; keine Übernahme nicht belegbarer Inhalte; Schutz vor Prompt Injection; - integrierter Human-in-the-Loop-Pfad mit konfigurierbaren Aussteuerungsregeln und einer barrierefreien (BITV 2.0), deutschsprachigen, vollständig tastaturbedienbaren Nachbearbeitungsoberfläche; - Aufnahme weiterer Dokumentklassen ohne Neuaufsatz des Systems durch den Beitragsservice selbst; kein Training von Modellgewichten mit personenbezogenen Daten der Beitragszahlenden; - modellagnostische Architektur (vorzugsweise Open-Weight-Modelle), REST-Schnittstellen, Container-/Microservice-Architektur, UTF-8, Reporting (u. a. Precision/Recall/F1 je Dokumentklasse) und Anbindung an die Monitoring-Werkzeuge des Beitragsservice. Die Beschreibung der ausgeschriebenen Leistungen wird unter Ziffer 5.1. dieser Bekanntmachung fortgesetzt.
